mapper.delete: DELETE FROM SYS_ROLERES_REF rr WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SYS_MODULE_RESOURCES res WHERE rr.resource_id = res.id AND res.main_id = #{moduleId} )

SELECT r.ID, r.MAIN_ID, r.CODE, r.RESOURCE_DESC, r.RESOURCE_URL, r.RESOURCE_TYPE, r.SORT, CASE WHEN rr.ROLE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS CHECKED FROM SYS_MODULE_RESOURCES r LEFT JOIN SYS_ROLERES_REF rr ON r.ID = rr.RESOURCE_ID AND rr.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} WHERE (r.DELETED = 0 OR r.DELETED IS NULL) ORDER BY r.MAIN_ID ASC, r.SORT ASC, r.ID ASC
